# Health Data Readiness Level (HDRL) Assessment Framework

> The HDRL Framework is an open maturity framework for assessing readiness for trusted, federated health data research. Its first formative application was the 3 Nations Readiness Assessment; Research Data Scotland’s externally hosted Final Report is the authoritative source for assessment findings.

## Framework

- [Framework Overview](https://hdrlframework.org/framework/overview/)
- [Machine-readable Indicator Catalogue](https://hdrlframework.org/framework/indicator-catalogue/)
- [HDRL applied-v1 indicator catalogue (JSON)](https://hdrlframework.org/data/hdrl-indicators-v1.json)
- [HDRL applied-v1 indicator catalogue schema (JSON Schema)](https://hdrlframework.org/data/hdrl-indicators-v1.schema.json)
- [Methodology](https://hdrlframework.org/framework/methodology/)
- [Maturity Levels](https://hdrlframework.org/framework/maturity-levels/)
- [Indicator Classification](https://hdrlframework.org/framework/classification/)
- [Proposed Foundational Indicators](https://hdrlframework.org/framework/foundational-requirements/)

## Domains

- [Domain A: Data Coverage & Federation](https://hdrlframework.org/domains/a-data-coverage/)

- [Domain C: Governance & Access](https://hdrlframework.org/domains/c-governance-access/)
- [Domain D: Research Integration](https://hdrlframework.org/domains/d-research-integration/)
- [Domain E: Public Trust](https://hdrlframework.org/domains/e-public-trust/)
- [Domain F: Sustainability](https://hdrlframework.org/domains/f-sustainability/)
- [Domain G: Workforce & Culture](https://hdrlframework.org/domains/g-workforce-culture/)
- [Domain H: Infrastructure & Compute](https://hdrlframework.org/domains/h-infrastructure/)
